prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a transparent 2D CUTOUT ANIMATION PARTS SHEET for a new simplified dwarf game character. The supplied reference is identity guidance only: keep large reddish nose, thick eyebrows, gray-brown hair, broad gray beard, sturdy dwarf personality. Radically redesign proportions and anatomy for cheap expressive animation: huge head, compact broad pear-shaped torso, NO visible arms, NO visible legs. Charming grown-up dwarf, not baby. Clean bold dark outlines, restrained warm painted shading, much simpler than reference, readable at 120 pixels high. Teal work tunic, brown belt. Avoid realistic muscles, skin pores, tiny texture noise.

Layout: 1536x1024 transparent sheet, isolated pieces separated by at least 60 px, NO labels or background.
LEFT HALF (x50-700,y60-900): ONE combined HEAD-AND-TORSO piece, front facing. Full hair top and smoothly finished rounded belted tunic bottom, broad shoulder outline but NO arm stubs/cut-off flesh, NO sleeves extending sideways, NO attached hands, NO legs, NO boots. Head about 45% of this piece's height. Body reads as a complete stylized pawn silhouette designed for floating hands and tiny boots, not an amputated realistic body.
TOP RIGHT (x820-1100,y100-360): ONE separate small rounded leather mitten/fist, front-facing, fingers closed around an imaginary vertical grip. Simple oval block with thumb, no wrist/forearm. 
MIDDLE RIGHT (x820-1100,y470-760): ONE separate squat leather boot, front-facing, large toe with only a very short cuff, NO leg.
FAR RIGHT (x1200-1470,y100-900): ONE upright compact mining pickaxe, metal pick head horizontal at top, straight wooden handle vertical downwards. Full object isolated.
All pieces exact same hand-painted cartoon style, orthographic front view, transparent alpha. This is NEW production raster artwork, not a 3D render, not a screenshot, not a full character with attached limbs.
